summary: This dataset contains three models for estimating the Foveal Avascular Zone (FAZ) area from OCT B-scan images: Model 1 predicts FAZ length from images, Model 2 predicts FAZ area from length measurements, and Model 3 converts FAZ area from pixels to square millimeters. The dataset includes 1,146 OCT B-scan images (128 × 128 pixels) with corresponding FAZ length or area measurements in pixels, provided in BMP format and a CSV file. The dataset is used for training and evaluating machine learning algorithms to estimate FAZ area from OCT images.
